name: Production Deploy
description: Workflow for deploying the current build to production with pre-flight checks.

steps.task: Run the full test suite (unit, integration, E2E). Generate a test report. Block deployment if critical tests fail.
Run pre-deployment checks: build succeeds, environment variables set, database migrations ready. Create a deployment snapshot/backup.
Execute deployment: push to production, run migrations, verify health checks pass, confirm SSL and DNS. Roll back if health checks fail.
Post-deployment smoke tests: verify critical user flows work in production. Report any issues immediately.
Confirm deployment success. Notify stakeholders. Update project status.
